## Open

### F-158 — A package can declare `ci-test` while having no test files

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-lint · open_

`core/blong-lint` has no test files at all, yet it declares a `ci-test` script, so both the old and
the new script exit 1 for it. The message — 'no valid test files found' — comes from `tap`, not from
the script, which makes it easy to mistake for a regression introduced by editing the script.

Check whether a package has any tests before blaming a change to its test script.

### F-252 — A file-scoped lint run from the repo root checks spelling only

> _2026-09-24 · core/blong-lint · open_

Ran `blong-dev lint --files <paths>` from the repository root and read the pass as a clean gate: it
printed cspell and markdown only, and two type errors in a file I had just edited went unnoticed
until the editor flagged them. blong-lint gates tsc and eslint on the working directory
(`hasTsConfig(cwd)`, `hasEslintConfig(cwd)`), so from a directory that has neither, those two tools
do not run and the ✓ line lists only what did — a pass that is spelling alone, with nothing saying a
tool was skipped. Run lint from the package that owns the files (`node --run ci-lint -- <paths>`)
and read the ✓ lines to see which tools actually ran; the package run prints tsc, cspell and eslint.

## Resolved

### F-127 — A lint wrapper hid a reporter that never started

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-lint · resolved_

`cspell --reporter json` is not built in: it resolves the separate `cspell-json-reporter` package
and exits 1 with `Failed to load reporter json` while printing nothing at all to stdout. The
diagnostics parser found no output, so it reported 'clean' and `blong-dev lint` printed `✓ cspell` —
and still exited 1.

`@feasibleone/blong-lint` now parses cspell's default `path:line:col - message` reporter and only
falls back to JSON if that parses. A wrapper that treats 'no parsed diagnostics' as success hides a
tool that failed to start, so always propagate the child's exit code.

### F-149 — A structural copy of a type can fail where the real type compiles

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-lint · resolved_

`DiagnosticReport.diagnostics` only type-checks against `@feasibleone/blong-lint`'s `Diagnostic`,
not against a loose `{[key: string]: unknown}` shape, because of the index-signature check. Import
and use the exported type instead of re-declaring a look-alike.

### F-150 — The `blong-lint` / `blong-dev` cycle hid in `package.json` scripts

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-lint · resolved_

The `core/blong-lint` to `tools/blong-dev` dependency cycle existed only for two `npm run` scripts
(`blong-dev lint`, `blong-dev test`), so a grep for the package name in `*.ts` finds nothing: a
package-level cycle can hide entirely in `package.json` scripts. It was also invisible until
`rush update` re-resolved the graph with pnpm 10.33.2, the version `rush.json` pins, because the
older dependency set predates the check — a pnpm WARN of this kind reports a structural problem that
already existed, not a new one.
